_source: OSRIC 3.0 Player Guide: Bonus Spell Slots (Cleric 1.3.2), Arcane Spell Acquisition (Table 1.3.6.2A).

wisdom_bonus_cleric_spells._note: Cumulative extra spell slots for high-Wisdom clerics/druids, added to the slots from the class table. Higher-level bonus slots are only usable once the caster can cast that spell level.

arcane_spell_acquisition._note: Magic-User/Illusionist: chance (d100) to understand a new spell when trying to learn it, and the maximum number of spells understood per spell level, by Intelligence.
